title: Change Customer is still blocked by deposits and keeps its gray caption
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Use staging (preferred), or the Tiered Pricing QA site too once the release is deployed there; production is not needed.
  • Note the attached Today picture shows this screen before the release; the steps check that it still works the same way.
  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, left on Default for work orders and Part Sales.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer C, left on Default for work orders and Part Sales.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer B, with a deposit taken.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 2, for customer B, with no deposit.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Click Change Customer in the work order's three-dot menu.
  3. Open work order 2.
  4. Click Change Customer in the work order's three-dot menu.
  5. Pick customer C.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • Changing the customer is blocked, as today.
  • Work order 1 still names customer B.

Step 3:

  • Work order 2 opens.

Step 4:

  • The dialog shows today's gray caption "Updating the customer will change the account and contact on this work order." with Cancel and Update Customer.
  • The caption reads as in picture 14.3.

Step 5:

  • Customer C is picked and Update Customer turns on.
